narrative: Campus IT notice regarding scheduled weekend maintenance.

message.body: Scheduled Maintenance: Wi-Fi services will undergo maintenance on Saturday from 2 AM to 5 AM. No action is required from users.

evidence.label: Message Type
evidence.value: Informational notice; asks for no credentials or clicks

evidence.label: Campus IT Announcement Portal
evidence.value: Portal lists scheduled maintenance window for Saturday.

consequence_text.safe: You verified the IT announcement on the college portal.
consequence_text.unsafe: Reporting routine maintenance notices creates unnecessary helpdesk clutter.

teaching_point: System maintenance notices that require no action are authentic.
